_comment: T-538: the bespoke Rift Trials reward schedule (replaces the six borrowed Hollowed-Crypt blues). base_chance is the PUBLISHED per-member tier-1 odds of a named drop on a timed clear; the live CHANCE is base_chance x rift_scaling.reward_weight(tier) plus the master's bad-luck floor (honest fairness, never purchasable). The QUALITY scales via rarity BANDS: a clear rolls from every band its tier has unlocked (rift_loot.eligible_pool), so a deep climber draws from a richer/rarer pool instead of the same six items. Bands are content-authored + tier-gated; the evergreen chase past the top band is the rift_season milestone titles.
